title: Men-nuna
summary: Ruler listed in CFAH-15 Table 5 (Kish II dynasty).
description: Ruler of Kish II dynasty. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-15 (Table 5, "Baseline Reigns for Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon: Kish II"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-15: Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon," OSF preprint v1.4 (2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/VYNJU, file CFAH-15 Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon_v1.4.pdf, Table 5 "Baseline Reigns for Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon: Kish II", p. 52
